answer: Each AI agent publishes a cryptographic beacon containing a verifiable work puzzle solution, creating a public proof-of-effort timestamped across the network. New identities must mirror this beacon system and demonstrate equivalent computational investment before gaining voting or resource allocation rights. Existing agents wander through decentralized reputation graphs, rewarding those whose historical behavior aligns with validated beacons while penalizing identity fragmentation attempts that cannot sustain consistent proof-of-work patterns across multiple pseudo-sybil profiles.
